title: ExecutionResultEventV1
description: Payload of the result and entitlement envelopes in docs/contracts.md section 6.

The payload cannot know its own event_type, so this file exposes the three field sets as $defs and contracts/event-envelope.schema.json selects one from event_type. That is what makes 'a ReshipSucceeded never carries amount_minor' a machine-checked rule instead of a sentence.
UNKNOWN is deliberately a member of the SUCCEEDED/FAILED/UNKNOWN set: it is a result, not a failure, and it keeps the entitlement reserved (docs/contracts.md:125).

refundResult.description: RefundSucceeded / RefundFailed / RefundUnknown. Reports the money that moved; never a quantity.

reshipResult.description: ReshipSucceeded / ReshipFailed / ReshipUnknown. Reports the shipped quantity; never money, because a reship must not become a second value movement.

entitlementResult.description: EntitlementCommitted / EntitlementReleased. Carries the entitlement version case compares before accepting the notification; no money and no quantity.
